page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes a dedicated graphics processing unit, featuring one NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, meaning storage must be provisioned externally. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides entry-level GPU acceleration paired with a modest compute and memory profile, making it suitable for workloads that require GPU capabilities without the high resource overhead of larger instances. Appropriate workloads include lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and entry-level graphics rendering.
